segments.name: Broadband communications
segments.description: Provides data, video and voice services to residential and business subscribers in non-metropolitan and secondary markets across Western, Midwestern and Southern states.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, management has identified one operating segment, which is its reportable segment, under this organizational and reporting structure.

revenueModel.text: Residential and business subscribers pay monthly subscription or contract fees for data, video and voice services.
revenueModel.evidence: Residential revenues are generated through individual and bundled subscriptions for data, video and voice services.
